source.check: returned unopposed: 'There are eleven unopposed returns to Derry Rural Council. Two seats are being contested - Claudy ... and the Middle Liberties' (Derry Journal 23 May 1958 p7, image read), which names each unopposed member with the division.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. Two contests, Claudy and Middle Liberties (Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1958, p. 5; Irish News, 6 June 1958, p. 1). The eleven unopposed members added from the Derry Journal, 23 May 1958, p. 7, which names each with the division (Upper Liberties printed as his townland) (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
